items.why_title: Why VpnHood! leads the free tier
items.why_desc: Most "free" VPNs cap your data, hide features behind a paywall, or keep their code closed. VpnHood! CONNECT does none of that.
items.why_unlimited_desc: No data caps, no bandwidth throttling and no account sign-up — connect and browse with the full free experience.
items.why_open_source_desc: Both the client and the server are fully open source, so anyone can audit exactly how your traffic is handled.
items.why_split_desc: Split traffic by country, by app and by local network — control that rival free tiers simply don't offer.
